title: Locked pretension with an external centre load
source: Closed-form two-spring equilibrium with a locked compatibility jump; q and the two stresses follow the two equations shown in README.md.

quantities.reason: The locked value is the preceding two-segment preload: q = 10(1/1000 + 1/2000) = 0.015 m.

quantities.quantity: lower segment axial stress after the centre load (Pa)
quantities.reason: Let y and z be the lower and upper centre displacements. The locked compatibility is y − z = 0.015; the centre equilibrium is σ1 − σ2 = 3 Pa, and compatibility is (σ1 − 10)/1000 + (σ2 − 10)/2000 = 0. Solving gives the independent reference stress.

quantities.quantity: upper segment axial stress after the centre load (Pa)
